planets.name: K2-139 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-139 with a 28.4-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-139 b was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-139. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
